Turnover Bidder Turnover Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March 2026 of the previous fi nancial year, should be Rs 09 lacs i.e. approximately 30% of the case value, as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of (audited B alance Sheet and Profit & Loss account statement of preceding three years or tu rnover certificate of preceding three years issued by a Chartered Accountant with Unique Identification Number (UDIN) to be uploaded) with the bid. ugh re-seller(s)} should have supplied at least 160 MT (80% of Total i ndented quantity ) of Ferric Alum in at least one of the last three Finan cial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Orga nization / PSU. Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulati ve order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS A) Guarantee/ Warranty and Interchangeability Clauses-- Not applicable being consumable items B) QUANTITY TOLERANCE CLAUSE AS PER NIT APPLICABLE, WHICH IS +/- 5% OF ORDERED QUANTITY TO ACCOUNT FOR ANY WEIGHMENT VARIATION.
